subject: general
question: Who among the following Kushana kings was the founder of the Kushana dynasty?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kujula Kadphises**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kujula Kadphises** was the founder of the Kushana dynasty.
 
• The Kushana dynasty played a significant role in the history of India and Central Asia, especially during the early centuries of the Common Era.
 
• Kujula Kadphises established the Kushana empire in the 1st century CE, which later expanded under his successors.
 
• Under the Kushana rule, there was significant cultural exchange and economic prosperity, with notable developments in art, architecture, and trade.
 
• The dynasty is known for its patronage of Buddhism and the spread of Buddhist culture along the Silk Road.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Kushana dynasty's most famous rulers include **Kanishka**, who is known for his military, political, and spiritual achievements.
 
• The Kushana empire facilitated the spread of Buddhism to Central Asia and China, significantly influencing the development of Mahayana Buddhism.
 
• The dynasty issued a large number of gold and copper coins, which provide valuable insights into their reign and the cultural syncretism of the period.
 
• The Kushana period is also notable for the development of the Gandhara and Mathura schools of art, which combined Indian, Persian, and Greek artistic traditions.
 
• The capital of the Kushana empire was initially in Bactria (modern-day Afghanistan) and later moved to Peshawar (in present-day Pakistan).
